title: indian shares track muted open oil climbs rising mideast risks 2026 09 08
text:
Sept 8 (Reuters) - Indian shares edged lower on Tuesday, following the benchmarks' six-week low hit in the previous session, as ​sentiment remained subdued due to the widening Middle East conflict pushing crude prices higher.
The ‌Nifty 50 (.NSEI)
, opens new tab
 lost 0.46% at 23,668.85 and the BSE Sensex (.BSESN)
, opens new tab
 fell 0.53% to 75,727.30 as of 10:06 a.m. IST.
Any new attacks on Tehran will be met with retaliation on U.S. ​assets, Iran threatened on Monday, and warned that energy infrastructure across the ​Gulf, including U.S. oil and gas interests, was vulnerable.
Rising crude prices ⁠and renewed US–Iran hostilities are keeping risk appetite subdued, analysts said.
"Nifty could ​remain volatile around key support levels, while any recovery is likely to face ​selling at higher levels. Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst at Choice Broking.
Brent crude futures rose 0.6% to around $98 per barrel. India is particularly vulnerable to higher fuel prices as it imports about ​85% of its crude requirements.
Twelve of the 16 major domestic sectors logged ​losses. Heavyweight financials (.NIFTYFIN)
, opens new tab
 fell 0.7% and private banks (.NIFPVTBNK)
, opens new tab
 slid 0.6%.
The three heaviest benchmark stocks, HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS)
, opens new tab
, ‌ICICI ⁠Bank (ICBK.NS)
, opens new tab
 and Reliance Industries (RELI.NS)
, opens new tab
 shed 0.7%, 1.1% and 0.6%, respectively.
The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100)
, opens new tab
 and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100)
, opens new tab
 fell 0.3% each.
Among individual stocks, GE Vernova T&D India (GETD.NS)
, opens new tab
 climbed 8% after securing a high-voltage direct current contract from Power Grid (PGRD.NS)
, opens new tab
.
Temasek-backed Indian logistics firm Shiprocket (SIPO.NS)
, opens new tab
, which ​went public on ​August 19, gained ⁠3.2% after its first-quarter loss narrowed.
"While the secondary market remains lacklustre, primary market continues to see strong action, with 12 ​IPOs opening this week, aiming to raise a combined 70 ​billion rupees ⁠in one of the busiest weeks of the current IPO cycle," said Siddhartha Khemka, head of research of wealth management at Motilal Oswal Financial.
State-owned Bharat Electronics (BAJE.NS)
, opens new tab
 and ⁠Hindustan ​Aeronautics (HIAE.NS)
, opens new tab
 added 2.3% and 3.7%, respectively, after India's ​defence acquisition council approved various proposals at an estimated cost of 1.1 trillion rupees.
